A policy that raises escapes the worker task, and `runner.py:590` logs `Worker task failed unexpectedly` and drops it. The... (Ref: https://github.com/run-llama/llama-agents/pull/807)

Fix: Support unhashable workflows in serializer caching. Target files: packages/llama-index-workflows/src/workflows/runtime/types/plugin.py, packages/llama-agents-integration-tests/tests/test_context_store.py, packages/llama-index-workflows/tests/context/test_workflow_serializer.py. `Runtime._serializer_cache` uses `WeakKeyDictionary`, which still hashes workflow instances and rejects subclasses that set `__hash__ = None`. (Ref: https://github.com/run-llama/llama-agents/pull/762)

Fix: Don't crash ctx.store edits on non-deepcopyable state values. Target files: packages/llama-index-workflows/src/workflows/context/state_store.py, packages/llama-agents-integration-tests/tests/test_context_store.py, packages/llama-index-workflows/tests/context/test_state_store_facade.py. Every `ctx.store` write copies the whole live state before the edit, so a concurrent reader keeps seeing the committed state until the `edit_state` block finishes. The copy is a deep copy, and that is the problem. State often holds live ... (Ref: https://github.com/run-llama/llama-agents/pull/714)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Memory leak: AgentWorkflow stores heavy objects in ContextVar, pinned by asyncio task Context snapshots
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix memory leak from copied RunContext. Target files: packages/llama-index-workflows/src/workflows/runtime/control_loop.py, packages/llama-index-workflows/src/workflows/runtime/types/plugin.py, packages/llama-index-workflows/tests/test_workflow.py. asyncio `TimerHandle`s capture the current `Context` at schedule time, which pinned the workflow's `RunContext` ContextVar until the timer fired. Long-lived periodic timers (e.g. aiohttp's `TCPConnector` cleanup) kept workflows alive indefinitely. (Ref: https://github.com/run-llama/llama-agents/pull/486)
